name: ACC New Hope Program
neighborhoods: Citywide (the mechanism 200+ NYC rescues use to pull ACC dogs)
region_note: CITYWIDE BACKBONE & MUNICIPAL (the spine of NYC dog rescue)
notes: How nearly every NYC rescue gets ACC dogs out. Rescues take ownership of ACC animals (often medical/behavior cases) and rehome through their own process. If you want to foster/adopt an at-risk 'New Hope Only' dog, fill out the pre-screener and ACC matches you to a partner rescue. Partner packet mails to 11 Park Place Suite 805, NY 10007. Not a direct-to-public adoption channel - it feeds the rescues in this sheet. Other channel: At-risk list updated daily on nycacc.org
